photoEvents.name: UNANCA Human Rights Luncheon
photoEvents.description: Photos from the Annual UNA-NCA Human Rights Luncheon, held December 10, 2010, at the Cannon House Office Building, Capitol Hill, Washington, D.C.. Photos also include snapshots from UN Week -- a celebratioon of United Nations Day spread out over a week of events, which we ended with a special tribute for former UNA-NCA president, Andrew E. Rice. [Annual Report I wrote and designed accessible here <a href='https://www.unanca.org/images/content/publications/annual-reports/una-nca/Annual_Report_2010-2011.pdf' target='_blank' style='color: #00e6ff; text-decoration: underline; font-weight: bold;'>].
